title: Graph Learning for Cross-Subject, Cross-Population EEG Emotion Decoding and Model-Derived Spatial-Spectral Neural Signatures
abstract: arXiv:2609.22103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a noninvasive means of capturing emotion-related neural dynamics, yet reliable EEG emotion decoding lacks models that can both generalize to unseen individuals and populations while preserving neural interpretability. To address these challenges, EmoDiPyraTrans is proposed as a development-regularized differential graph Transformer that models temporally ordered relative power spectral density graphs through adaptive graph recurrence, differential attention, and multiscale fusion. The framework was evaluated at three connected levels. First, cross-subject evaluations on SEED, FACED, MAHNOB-HCI, DEAP and DREAMER yielded participant-mean accuracies of 0.928, 0.645, 0.714, 0.617 and 0.671, respectively; the model ranked first among the evaluated methods for accuracy and positive-class F1 on all five datasets. translated_title: 基于图学习的跨被试、跨人群脑电情绪解码及模型衍生的空间-频谱神经特征
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）提供了一种无创捕捉情绪相关神经动态的手段，然而可靠的脑电情绪解码目前缺乏既能够泛化到未见个体和人群、又能保持神经可解释性的模型。为应对这些挑战，本文提出EmoDiPyraTrans，一种发展正则化的差分图Transformer，通过自适应图循环、差分注意力和多尺度融合来建模时间有序的相对功率谱密度图。该框架在三个相互关联的层面进行了评估。首先，在SEED、FACED、MAHNOB-HCI、DEAP和DREAMER数据集上的跨被试评估分别获得了0.928、0.645、0.714、0.617和0.671的参与者平均准确率；该模型在所有五个数据集上的准确率和正类F1指标均在所评估的方法中排名第一。在七种消融实验方案中，差分注意力是唯一一个移除后（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出EmoDiPyraTrans——一种发展正则化差分图Transformer，通过自适应图循环、差分注意力和多尺度融合建模时间有序的相对功率谱密度图，在五个公开脑电数据集的跨被试情绪解码中均取得最优性能，同时保持了神经可解释性。
en_tdlr: EmoDiPyraTrans, a development-regularized differential graph Transformer that models temporally ordered relative power spectral density graphs via adaptive graph recurrence, differential attention, and multiscale fusion, achieves state-of-the-art cross-subject EEG emotion decoding across five public datasets while preserving neural interpretability.
